static_traits.name: Chen Bowen
static_traits.social_status: 有少数朋友可交流，但尚not yet与他们谈及对诗歌的自卑感
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems before; has not received psychotherapy; no major physical illness

basic_info.main_problem: 我常常觉得自己是最糟糕的Poet，尤其当有人批评我的作品时。这种not够好的感觉始于几个月前一位朋友not喜欢我的一首诗。
basic_info.core_demands: 负面反馈及随后的自我not足感显著影响我享受写作的能力，促使我寻求咨询。
growth_experiences: 几个月前，朋友明确表示not喜欢来访者的一首诗。自那次经历后，来访者在分享作品时经常Anticipation会Being rejected或Receiving negative feedback，持续出现“自己是最糟糕的Poet”的自我贴标签与not够好的感受，并报告创意与写作Decreased confidence、写作Impaired motivation、与同行交流减少。

core_beliefs: I am not good enough（作为Poet）
My value depends on others' evaluations

special_situations.event: 朋友明确表示not喜欢来访者的一首诗
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果有人not喜欢我的作品，就说明我作为Poet是失败的/not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to improve writing skills and seek others' approval to prove oneself

special_situations.event: 在向他人分享诗作前，来访者Anticipation会Being rejected或Receiving negative feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果遭到拒绝或负评，就证明I have no value，not该继续写诗
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids sharing works, reduces communication with other writers
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会讨厌我的诗，They definitely think I am terrible

special_situations.event: After receiving criticism, associates it with long-term negative consequences (creativity and confidence destroyed)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次批评意味着我会持续写not好、能力下降且难以Recovery
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces or pauses writing to avoid failing and being hit again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我的写作完了，我再也写not出好诗

special_situations.event: 为缓解not安而频繁寻求他人认可与肯定
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有得到他人的认可，我才是有价值的Poet
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断向他人询问评价、寻找正面反馈以安抚Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果have not人认可，我就not值得被称为Poet

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被他人认可与欣赏（作为Poet）
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected与被negate，担心自己have not价值
defense_goal: 通过回避分享来降低被negate的风险
通过寻求外部认可来暂时缓解not安

object_relations.object_representation: Picky/critical others or readers (such as friends)

positive_force: 具备文学专业训练背景（Bachelor's degree in literature）
Has basic social support (a few friends to communicate with)
Proactively trying to improve writing and seeking help (willingness for self-improvement)
negative_force: Excessive reliance on external recognition to determine self-worth
Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking等认知扭曲
在分享前Anticipation拒绝导致回避行为
将一次负面反馈泛化为整体能力not足，自我贴标签

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding sharing poems and seeking feedback
antecedent: 当需要向他人分享作品或Anticipation会收到评价时
想到朋友曾not喜欢自己的作品
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕Being rejected与被negate，将一次负面反馈视为自我失败的证据
target_behavior.function: 逃避可能的负面评价以保护自尊、降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 与同行Relationship estrangement、反馈减少，创作动力与Decreased confidence

target_behavior.behavior: 灾难化的Self-denial思维（如“I am the worst poet”）
antecedent: When receiving or recalling negative feedback
When creation is blocked or facing criticism
target_behavior.core_reason: 核心信念“I am not good enough”，以极端方式评估自我价值并将单次批评泛化
target_behavior.function: 通过自我贴标签为挫败提供“确定性Interpretation”，短期缓解not确定性带来的Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 创造力与Decreased confidence，难以享受写作，并出现Persistent anxiety与回避

antecedent: After being activated by negative thoughts
target_behavior.core_reason: 将批评视为持久能力not足的证据，害怕再次失败与受挫
target_behavior.function: 避免面对可能的失败与not适感
target_behavior.consequence: Writing time decreases, output lowers, willingness to write in spare time is impaired
